resources.string: Voice was not started. You can type your answer here.
Microphone access was not granted. Voice was not started; you can type your answer here.
Voice setup was interrupted. Type your answer here, or retry voice from this screen.
Dictation adds words to this draft. Edit them, then tap Send. Hands-free runs the spoken interview instead.

Microphone access is needed only after you tap Start dictation. Your phone’s speech service processes audio, on-device where available. Stop dictation keeps the recognized words in your editable draft; only Send submits it. Leaving this screen cancels dictation. No background listening or notification is needed.
Waiting for microphone access. Your draft is unchanged.
Listening for dictation. Tap Stop dictation when finished. Finish words and commands are ordinary text here.
Microphone stopping… Keeping the available words.
Microphone off. Transcribing recorded audio… Send remains explicit.
Dictation added to your draft. Review or edit it, then tap Send.
No speech was recognized. Your draft is unchanged; retry dictation or type.
Microphone access was denied. Your draft is unchanged. Allow the microphone in Android app settings to retry, or type.
Dictation cancelled. Your existing draft is kept; unfinished audio was not added.
Dictation stopped before completion. Any available words were kept; review your draft before Send.
Dictation failed. Your draft is unchanged; retry or type.
End your answer with “%1$s”. Commands must be the whole utterance: “repeat”, “skip this one”, “write it up”, “scratch that”, “pause” or “exit voice”. Resume always needs a tap.
No sound is reaching the recogniser. Keep IdeaForge open, or check the microphone.

Microphone access is needed only for your voice interview. Your phone’s speech service processes audio, on-device where available. IdeaForge stores no audio. Listening can continue with the screen off; Pause stops capture and keeps the words already available.
Microphone access was denied, so voice stood down. You can keep typing, or allow the microphone in Settings and tap Resume.
App settings could not be opened. Open Android Settings, find IdeaForge, then allow the microphone. Return here and tap Resume, or Exit to type.
Allow notifications to keep Pause, Resume and Exit available outside this screen. Refusing notifications does not block voice; the controls remain here.
Notifications are off, so the Pause and Exit controls stay on this screen only.
Shown while a hands-free interview is using the microphone, with Pause and Exit.
